files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: calculate
tool_schemas.description: Evaluates a math expression string and returns the computed result. It accepts only expressions made up of numbers, + - * / operators, parentheses, and spaces. It refuses requests with a missing/empty expression or with invalid characters or malformed syntax it cannot parse or evaluate.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to calculate, such as '2 + 2'. The expression can contain numbers, operators (+, -, *, /), parentheses, and spaces.
expression.title: Expression

tool_schemas.name: cancel_pending_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an order that is still in a pending state and returns the updated order details after the cancellation is applied. It validates that the order_id is provided (including the leading '#') and that reason is one of: 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'. It refuses requests when the order cannot be found, is not pending (for example already processed or delivered), or when required fields are missing or invalid.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

reason.description: The reason for cancellation, which should be either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.
reason.title: Reason

tool_schemas.name: exchange_delivered_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Exchanges specified items from a delivered order for replacement items of the same product type and returns the updated order reflecting the exchange and any price-difference charge or refund applied to the provided payment method. It requires order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids, and payment_method_id, and it validates that item_ids and new_item_ids are the same length and that each replacement corresponds positionally to an item of the same product type. It refuses requests if the order is not found, not delivered, has already had a post-delivery return/exchange performed, any listed item is not in the order (or quantity is inconsistent with duplicates), any replacement item is incompatible, or the payment method cannot be used for the adjustment.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

item_ids.description: The item ids to be exchanged, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.
item_ids.title: Item Ids

new_item_ids.description:
The item ids to be exchanged for, each such as '1008292230'.
There could be duplicate items in the list. Each new item id should match the item id
in the same position and be of the same product.
new_item_ids.title: New Item Ids

payment_method_id.description:
The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference,
such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up
from the user or order details.
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id

tool_schemas.name: find_user_id_by_name_zip
tool_schemas.description:
Find user id by first name, last name, and zip code. If the user is not found, the function

will return an error message. By default, find user id by email, and only call this function
if the user is not found by email or cannot remember email.

first_name.description: The first name of the customer, such as 'John'.
first_name.title: First Name

last_name.description: The last name of the customer, such as 'Doe'.
last_name.title: Last Name

zip.description: The zip code of the customer, such as '12345'.
zip.title: Zip

tool_schemas.name: find_user_id_by_email
tool_schemas.description: Find user id by email. If the user is not found, the function will return an error message.

email.description: The email of the user, such as 'something@example.com'.
email.title: Email

tool_schemas.name: get_order_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an order’s current status and full details and returns the order record for the supplied order_id. It validates that order_id is provided and formatted as expected (including the leading '#'). It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid or when no order exists for that identifier.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

tool_schemas.name: get_product_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns catalog and inventory information for a product type identified by product_id (not an item id). It validates that product_id is provided and refers to a product type in the catalog. It refuses requests when product_id is missing/invalid or when the product does not exist.

product_id.description: The product id, such as '6086499569'. Be careful the product id is different from the item id.
product_id.title: Product Id

tool_schemas.name: get_item_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns catalog and inventory information for a specific purchasable item identified by item_id (not a product id). It validates that item_id is provided and refers to a known item. It refuses requests when item_id is missing/invalid or when the item does not exist.

item_id.description: The item id, such as '6086499569'. Be careful the item id is different from the product id.
item_id.title: Item Id

tool_schemas.name: get_user_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns a user profile along with their associated orders for the supplied user_id. It validates that user_id is provided and matches an existing user. It refuses requests when user_id is missing/invalid or when the user cannot be found.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_product_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists all product types in the store and returns their display names and product_ids (up to the full catalog of 50 product types). It does not require any parameters. It refuses requests that include unsupported parameters or otherwise fail basic request validation.

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_address
tool_schemas.description: Updates the shipping address on a pending order and returns the updated order details with the new address applied. It requires order_id plus address1, address2, city, state, country, and zip, and validates that all fields are present and non-empty where applicable. It refuses requests when the order is not found, is not pending (for example already processed or delivered), or when any required address field is missing or invalid.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

address1.description: The first line of the address, such as '123 Main St'.
address1.title: Address1

address2.description: The second line of the address, such as 'Apt 1' or ''.
address2.title: Address2

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Replaces specified items in a pending order with other items of the same product type and returns the updated order reflecting the changes and any price-difference charge or refund applied to the provided payment method. It requires order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids, and payment_method_id, and validates that item_ids and new_item_ids are the same length and that each replacement corresponds positionally to an item of the same product type. It refuses requests if the order is not found, not pending, has already had its items modified once, any listed item is not in the order (or quantity is inconsistent with duplicates), any replacement item is incompatible, or the payment method cannot be used for the adjustment.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

item_ids.description: The item ids to be modified, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.
item_ids.title: Item Ids

new_item_ids.description: The item ids to be modified for, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list. Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
new_item_ids.title: New Item Ids

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_payment
tool_schemas.description: Updates the payment method on an existing order that is still pending and returns the updated order/payment details. Refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, the order is not in a pending state, or the payment_method_id is missing/invalid or not available for that order/user. Refuses the change if the order is already processed/shipped/canceled or the payment method cannot be used (for example, not owned by the user or otherwise ineligible).

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id

tool_schemas.name: modify_user_address
tool_schemas.description: Replaces a user’s default shipping address with the provided address fields and returns the updated user/address details. Refuses requests when the user_id is missing/unknown, any required address field is missing, or the address fails basic validation (for example, empty lines where required). Refuses updates when the caller is not allowed to change that user’s address or the address cannot be set as a default for the account.

address1.description: The first line of the address, such as '123 Main St'.
address1.title: Address1

address2.description: The second line of the address, such as 'Apt 1' or ''.
address2.title: Address2

tool_schemas.name: return_delivered_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Creates a return request for specific item instances from a delivered order, changes the order status to “return requested,” and returns the updated order/return details (with follow-up instructions sent separately). Refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, the order is not delivered, the item_ids list is missing/empty, or any listed item does not belong to the order or is not return-eligible. Refuses the request when the payment_method_id is missing/invalid or cannot be used for the refund/adjustment, or when the requested return conflicts with the order’s current state (for example, already in a return flow).

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.
order_id.title: Order Id

item_ids.description: The item ids to be returned, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.
item_ids.title: Item Ids

payment_method_id.description:
The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'.
These can be looked up from the user or order details.
payment_method_id.title: Payment Method Id

tool_schemas.name: transfer_to_human_agents
tool_schemas.description: Escalates the conversation to a human agent and passes along the provided summary, returning an acknowledgement of the handoff. Refuses requests when the summary is missing/empty or the handoff cannot be initiated from the current session/context. Refuses escalation when routing is unavailable or the caller is not permitted to create a human-agent transfer for the conversation.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.
summary.title: Summary

metadata.name: MercantileCare Operations Hub
metadata.description: A retail commerce support service that powers product and item lookups, customer identity retrieval, and post‑purchase order actions like cancellations, exchanges, returns, payment/address updates, and human agent escalation.
